query: UPDATE scan_tasks t SET state = 'claimed', worker_id = $2, claimed_at = now(), attempts = t.attempts + 1, stage = 'starting', stage_at = now(), stage_done = NULL, stage_total = NULL, stage_detail = NULL FROM scan_runs r WHERE t.id = $1 AND r.id = t.run_id AND t.state NOT IN ('done','failed','skipped') AND r.state <> 'cancelled' RETURNING t.id
